checkpoints.description: [1/2] Pin the save/load boundary end to end

impact_assessment.why: deterministic resume was proven at the engine level only; the browser routes (/api/save, /api/reset, /api/load) had no test that the RNG stream, evolved trade links and clock survive a real round trip, and the deep invariant sweep had never been run on five seeds
impact_assessment.benefits: the user-facing save/load path proves the same guarantee, and the deep invariant sweep (ids, bounds, cargo signs, population, devastation, contracts) is documented clean across five seeds including a full 2,000-step campaign
impact_assessment.risks: contract: none, test-only change; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none
impact_assessment.mitigation: one integration test through the real HTTP server plus probe self-tests that prove the checker catches synthetic violations

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Save slots each keep their own stream and never touch each other

impact_assessment.why: ADR-405 put the RNG checkpoint in every save, so independent slots had to be pinned: players keep branches in different slots and storage shares a data directory
impact_assessment.benefits: each slot provably restores its own stream, tick and credits, and loading one slot leaves the other byte-identical
impact_assessment.risks: contract: none, test-only; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none
impact_assessment.mitigation: three tests over the real StorageManager covering per-slot resume, listing and cross-slot immutability

checkpoints.description: [1/2] A pre-jump checkpoint replays the same risky jump

impact_assessment.why: ADR-301 rolls a checkpoint before low-security jumps and ADR-405 made saves carry the live RNG stream, but nothing pinned that reloading the checkpoint faces the same encounter instead of a re-roll
impact_assessment.benefits: the pre-jump safety net is proven replayable end to end over the real checkpoint writer
impact_assessment.risks: contract: none, test-only; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none
impact_assessment.mitigation: two tests: a low-security jump writes the slot and replaying it reproduces the live state field for field (clock excluded), and a high-security jump writes nothing

checkpoints.description: [1/2] An autosave follows the loaded slot

impact_assessment.why: StorageManager had no active-slot notion, so the ticker and per-step autosaves always wrote the default file; loading alpha and playing silently overwrote the default branch (reproduced: default 111 became 222)
impact_assessment.benefits: named campaigns autosave into themselves and a second branch is never clobbered; the pre-jump checkpoint slot stays a safety net
impact_assessment.risks: contract: StorageManager.save gains an activate keyword with a default that preserves explicit-slot saves; dependency: none; concurrency: the existing write lock already serializes saves; state: active_slot lives in memory only and starts at default
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first storage tests for all six transitions plus a server-level new-game/time-step test, full suite and project gates
